name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, take a shoulder-width underhand grip on a barbell, and hinge forward at your hips with soft knees.
Brace your core with a flat spine so the bar hangs straight down beneath your shoulders.
Drive your elbows smoothly back close to your ribs to pull the bar toward your lower abdomen.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension without lifting your torso.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and avoid curling the bar up with your biceps alone.
Maintain a steady torso angle rather than jerking upright with hip momentum.
